strings.support_methods_subtitle: Yer yoo me miiyo kony ma in imaro. Miiyo kony mo keken konyo me kwanyo jami ki i cim, gwoko, ki temo jami ma ki tiyo kwede.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis kare ki kare cwalo jami manyen ma ki lwongo ni firmwares pi lutuku ma calo Y1 (ma tye ka yubu jami ma ki kano ma calo 6.0, 7.0, ki 8.0) ma turo jami macon. Ma rac loyo, karatac gi me wilobo pe miyo ngec mo kiken ki twero mo keken me donyo i jami macon ma onongo tye ka tic me dwogo cen ki i kit ma onongo tye kwede. Lalok manyen ki yub me Community Firmware gi kwanyo jami ni: wa gwoko ROM macon weny, wa moko jami ma itiyo kwede, ki wa gwoko gin ma tuku ni tye ka tic maber.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Ka luyub jami gi mede anyim, lwak gi mede anyim.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Laro lutuku ma obale: neno ni jami ma ki medo i kom jami manyen pe balo jami macon.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROMs ma ki gwoko: jami ma ki nongo ki i factory macon Innioasis ki kwanyo woko.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Jami ma ki tiyo kwede me nyutu macOS, Linux, ki Windows marom.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Ryeko pa jami ma ki tiyo kwede: Gin ma ki lwongo ni Automatic board detection wek inong jami ma miite kare weny.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Gwoko cim ni ki i kom jami ma pe loko ki jami ma ki loko ma obale.
strings.support_story_2_body: Nongo jami ma ki lwongo ni Innioasis software pol kare kwako yenyo jami ma ki lwongo ni Google Drive ma kare ne otum, Baidu cloud ma ki poko, ki zip file ma pe ki ngeyo. Wa yubu gin ma ki geno, ma pe jenge i kom gin mo kiken ma tye ki SHA-256 ma ki moko, ngec ma ki medo, ki keto jami ma ki lubo rwom ki rwom. Mic ni gwoko jami ma ki kwanyo ki i cim ki gwoko ma miyo man twero time cawa 24 i nino acel acel, nino 365 i mwaka acel acel.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Pe tye Google Drives ma obale. Pe tye tic me byeko. Firmware tye ka tic kekene.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Oyoto, kwanyo direct labongo keto cik me kwanyo onyo link ma otum.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Medo ngec manyen: Nong ngec i kare ma dul manyen okati onyo jami ma ki yubu okati.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Kit me keto ne i yoo acel acel: jami ma ki neno ma nen maber obi telo in i kare ma i dii bute ni.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kabedo ma gi loko leb mapol: Ki loko i leb Munu, Chinese, German, Spanish, French & Japanese.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Jami ma tiyo oyot, ma ki moko ni jami ma ki tiyo kwede i kin lwak ma itwero jenge i kome.
strings.support_story_3_body: Jami ma ki tiyo kwede i factory ma ki lwongo ni Stock factory gi balo gin ma jami ma i Y1 onyo Y2 twero timo. Kabedo wa okelo Rockbox, jami tic ma yot ma ki yubu pi ngat acel acel, winyo jami ma ki winyo, ki jami ma ki yubu pi ngat acel acel. Wan wa wilo jami ma pat pat me temo, loko jami, ki moko jami weny ma ki keto. Miiyo kony bot Lalok manyen miiyo cente bot jami ma ki temo ni ki medo rwom me yubu jami ma ki lwongo ni firmware.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Yabo teko pa latuku ni weny.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback ki custom themes ma ki keto i ceken manok.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Medo teko pa mac, UI maleng, ki miiyo kony bot jami ma ki winyo.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Wa temo i kom jami ma nen ma tye adaa ma peya wa gonyo gin mo kiken ma ki yubu.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% labongo culu, jami ma ki keto me gwoko ngec pa ngat moni labongo ads onyo lubo kor jami.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Kelo Rockbox, jami tic ma yot ma ki yubu piri keni, ki bedo agonya pa dano ma maro winyo wer.
strings.support_story_4_body: Ka kampuni ma yubu jami me tic ocito i tic ki jami mukene, jami macon ni ki weko woko. Innioasis pe miiyo kony mo kiken me Linux, pe miiyo alokaloka mo kiken, ki pe miiyo yoo ma yot me dwoko cen ka keto ne obale. Lalok manyen tye pien dano ma maro tic kwede omyera pe gubol gin ma ki tiyo kwede me wer maber. 100% pa kony pa lwak cito i gwoko jami tic ni oyabe bot dano weny.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Kony wa me timo gin ma Innioasis pe timo.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Laro ki Yabo: Gin ma ki ngeyo ni dwoko piny maber kadi bed ni jami ma ki tiyo kwede okwero cako tic.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux me acel ma ki miiyo kony: MediaTek ma ki miiyo maber i Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Lok ma ki loko ma ki ngeyo: Lok ma ki coyo ma mako lok ma ki loko wek inge ngo ma ki loko.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% cente ma ki miiyo ki bot lwak: mwony acel acel gwoko ka gwoko jami macon ma oyabe ki nono bot dano weny.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Gwoko jami ma ki tiyo kwede i kin dano ma gwoko jami ni ki kama ki bolo iye yugi.

strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. Yab gin ma tuku ni kun imako bute ma ki lwongo ni Power.
2. Ka Rockbox oyabe, ket waya me USB i komputa ni.
3. Ka ki penyo i kom gin ma ki lwongo ni player, moko USB Storage mode wek gin ni onen calo drive.
